counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of arteriovenous malformations in other organs
No mention of high-flow vascular malformations
decisive_items: Detection of a heterozygous pathogenic KRIT1 variant
response.rationale: The presence of a KRIT1 variant and slow-flow vascular malformations supports the diagnosis of Capillary Malformation-Arteriovenous Malformation (CM-AVM) syndrome, which is a stronger candidate than Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome due to the specific genetic finding.

rejected.why: Lipolymphedema is a symptom, not a diagnosis
Venous malformation is a feature of the disease, but not the most comprehensive diagnosis
Cutaneovisceral angiomatosis with thrombocytopenia is not supported by the presence of a KRIT1 variant
Cerebral cavernous malformations are not directly related to the skin lesions and vascular malformations described
